scope: Gateway pagination contract for ecocredit batches and location attestations
finding: Both operator GET routes called services that enforce limits from 1 through 100, but FastAPI exposed an unbounded integer in OpenAPI and performed no route-level range validation.
change: Both route parameters now use FastAPI Query bounds ge=1 and le=100 with the existing default of 50. OpenAPI publishes the same range and FastAPI rejects invalid values before invoking the service.
rollback: Revert the Query bounds and focused regression; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: The checks cover OpenAPI generation and in-process request validation only; they do not establish live proxy behavior or database/service availability.
